title: Biquaternionic Space with Complex-valued Attention for Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion
abstract: arXiv:2609.14279v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Temporal knowledge graph embedding (TKGE) models infer missing facts in knowledge graphs that evolve over time. Many existing models use a single geometric space, which can limit their ability to represent diverse relational patterns, or treat entity representations as static. We propose Biquaternionic Space with Complex-valued Attention (BSCA), a TKGE model that combines circular and hyperbolic rotations within a unified biquaternionic framework. A complex-valued attention mechanism adaptively fuses time-conditioned and relation-conditioned entity representations, allowing them to vary with temporal and relational context. Experiments on five benchmark datasets show competitive performance across datasets, with the largest improvement on GDELT: BSCA achieves an MRR of 52.1\%, compared with 38.1\% for the strongest baseline in our comparison.

translated_title: 用于时序知识图谱补全的复值注意力双四元数空间
translated_abstract: 时序知识图谱嵌入（TKGE）模型用于推断随时间演化的知识图谱中缺失的事实。许多现有模型使用单一几何空间，这可能限制其表示多样化关系模式的能力，或者将实体表示视为静态的。我们提出了复值注意力双四元数空间（BSCA），这是一种时序知识图谱嵌入模型，它在统一的四元数框架内结合了圆形旋转和双曲旋转。复值注意力机制自适应地融合时间条件和关系条件的实体表示，使其能够随时间和关系上下文而变化。在五个基准数据集上的实验显示其在各数据集上均具有竞争力，其中在GDELT上取得了最大改进：BSCA达到了52.1%的MRR，而我们比较中最强的基线仅为38.1%。
tldr: BSCA模型在统一的四元数框架内结合圆形与双曲旋转，并通过复值注意力机制自适应融合时间和关系条件下的实体表示，在时序知识图谱补全任务上取得显著性能提升，在GDELT数据集上将MRR提升至52.1%。
en_tdlr: BSCA combines circular and hyperbolic rotations within a unified biquaternionic framework and uses a complex-valued attention mechanism to adaptively fuse time- and relation-conditioned entity representations, achieving significant performance gains in temporal knowledge graph completion, with MRR improved to 52.1% on GDELT.
